sample_unit: patients with unruptured intracranial aneurysms (case scenarios)

links.outcome: GPT-4 treatment recommendation quality and congruence with neurovascular board decisions
links.effect: No factual hallucinations; no specific recommendation derivable in 25% of cases; median expert quality rating 3.4/5; congruent with board in 65% of cases; moderate to low interrater agreement.
links.quote: None of the recommendations generated reflected evidence of factual hallucination, although in 25% of the case studies no specific recommendation could be derived from the GPT-4 responses.

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-4's ability to provide treatment recommendations for unruptured intracranial aneurysms using retrospective case vignettes compared against multidisciplinary board decisions.
